concerns: The headline quality claim rests on uncalibrated AI reviewers reading only the papers, with no human expert evaluation or calibration against human decisions, so workshop-level quality is not established.
The five-run sample with a single research model and no ablations cannot attribute outcomes to the question procedure, critic, or reviewer, leaving the central contribution underdetermined.

The post-hoc amendment counting the pilot after three results had been seen, and the post-hoc choice of PDF reviews as the main result after seeing Markdown reviews, introduce selection and reporting deviations that weaken the pre-registered evaluation.
scholarly_quality.concise_summary: While the experimental logging, reproducibility framework, and candor regarding protocol deviations are commendable, the paper's substantive evaluation of scientific quality rests entirely on uncalibrated external LLM reviewers without human expert corroboration across only five runs. Under conservative curation standards, the lack of independent ground truth or human calibration for paper quality warrants an uncertain verdict.

evidence.excerpt:
Systems such as The AI Scientist have shown that AI agents can carry out and write up
research, but in those demonstrations humans chose the research area and selected the outputs
to show. We study letting the AI formulate the research question itself, and we report every
run. Our system gives an off-the-shelf coding agent an instruction document and two skills: one
for formulating the question, in which the agent diverges from recent technologies into problems
of other fields, screens its candidates for known failure modes and obtains a critique from a
different model; and one for peer review, in which a reviewer from another model family re-
runs the study from its records before the agent revises the paper. Over 13 development runs,
changes to the one or two sentences that set the research area coincided with large shifts in what
the candidate questions and the chosen papers were

plain: a general-
purpose coding agent, an instruction document, and two skills (structured instructions loaded on
demand), with no bespoke orchestration code or experiment templates. The research-question skill

questions with no public ground truth. A different model critiques the top candidates once, and a
reviewer from another model family re-runs the study from its records before the agent revises the
paper.

evidence.excerpt:
sending any review, we fixed the
prompt, the output schema and the scripts. Two reviewers, Gemini 4 Argon (thinking level high,
Google Search tool) and Muse Wonder (reasoning effort max, web-search tool), each reviewed each
final paper twice in independent requests. They saw only the paper and could search the web;

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

blocking_reasons: The headline quality claim rests on uncalibrated AI reviewers reading only the papers, with no human expert evaluation or calibration against human decisions, so workshop-level quality is not established.
The five-run sample with a single research model and no ablations cannot attribute outcomes to the question procedure, critic, or reviewer, leaving the central contribution underdetermined.

The post-hoc amendment counting the pilot after three results had been seen, and the post-hoc choice of PDF reviews as the main result after seeing Markdown reviews, introduce selection and reporting deviations that weaken the pre-registered evaluation.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The external reviewers come from model families other than the research agent and were not involved in drafting or revision, and the in-loop reviewer re-ran the studies from records to verify reproducibility.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: External AI reviews by Gemini 4 Argon and Muse Wonder, which read only the final papers and scored them on six axes with workshop and main-track judgments.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The in-loop critic (GPT-6-astra) and in-loop reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5) shaped the papers through critique adoption and revision, and the system was developed over 13 runs with instruction changes informed by post-run assessments.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims of full autonomy from formulation to write-up and strict re-computability are supported by run records and deterministic replay scripts. However, claims regarding scientific quality and impact remain weakly corroborated due to reliance on uncalibrated LLM judges.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The primary evaluation relies on in-loop AI reviewer re-execution and external AI reviews by two separate LLMs (Gemini 4 Argon and Muse Wonder), which rate papers at workshop level but low in novelty and clarity. However, sample size is limited to five runs, no human expert evaluation or comparison against human baselines is provided, and the pre-registration protocol underwent a post-hoc amendment to include the pilot run.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Re-execution and reproducibility checks were verified independently through executable scripts from clean git tags, and external review signals came from distinct model families not involved in drafting.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: External automated reviews across 6 rubric axes and overall acceptance ratings from Gemini 4 Argon and Muse Wonder.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Internal multi-agent critique (GPT-6-astra) and in-loop execution review scoring (Claude Opus 5.5) that guide paper revision.

primary.limitations: The authors explicitly disclose protocol deviations (post-hoc counting of the pilot run), sample size limits (five runs, single research model family), lack of human evaluation, and the tendency of agents to converge on narrow open-data resources.
primary.method_assessment: The pipeline links an orchestrator agent, a research agent (GPT-6.1-sol), a cross-model critic (GPT-6-astra), and an in-loop reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5) that re-runs code from deterministic records. The operational workflow, tool interactions, prompt skills, and record manifests are described in detail.
primary.quality_rationale: While the experimental logging, reproducibility framework, and candor regarding protocol deviations are commendable, the paper's substantive evaluation of scientific quality rests entirely on uncalibrated external LLM reviewers without human expert corroboration across only five runs. Under conservative curation standards, the lack of independent ground truth or human calibration for paper quality warrants an uncertain verdict.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript presents an autonomous AI research system where agents formulate their own research questions within a broadly specified domain (societal problems using open data), critique and review them via multi-agent interactions, and write fully reproducible reports across five consecutive runs.

scholarly_quality.rationale: While the experimental logging, reproducibility framework, and candor regarding protocol deviations are commendable, the paper's substantive evaluation of scientific quality rests entirely on uncalibrated external LLM reviewers without human expert corroboration across only five runs. Under conservative curation standards, the lack of independent ground truth or human calibration for paper quality warrants an uncertain verdict.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors explicitly disclose protocol deviations (post-hoc counting of the pilot run), sample size limits (five runs, single research model family), lack of human evaluation, and the tendency of agents to converge on narrow open-data resources.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
